# HLOD

9 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `build_hlod`

*Destructive.*

Triggers a world HLOD build for the current editor world.  This is a HEAVY/async operation that requires a World Partition world plus the WorldPartitionHLODsBuilder commandlet / a long-running editor build job, so it cannot be driven synchronously from a single request. The tool does the headless-safe part for real (resolves the editor world, detects World Partition) and returns an honest result: build_started is false with a note explaining why (not a World Partition map, or async/commandlet-only).

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ world: string, is_world_partition: bool, build_started: bool, note?: string }`

## `create_hlod_layer`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Creates and saves a new UHLODLayer (World Partition HLOD layer) asset.  Idempotent on re-run: an HLOD layer already at the path is returned unchanged with created=false, already_exists=true and saved=false, layer_type not applied and nothing saved; an asset of another class there is an error. Sets default streaming-grid cell_size=25600, loading_range=51200. Layer type accepts 'Instancing', 'MeshApproximate' (also 'Custom'/'CustomHLODActor'). Defaults to 'Instancing'. A failed save makes success false with saved=false. Change it later with set_hlod_layer_settings.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Name of the new HLOD layer asset |
| `package_path` | string | no | Content folder; defaults to /Game/HLOD |
| `layer_type` | string | no | Optional EHLODLayerType string; defaults to "Instancing" |

**Returns:** `{ name: string, package_path: string, asset_path: string, layer_type: string, cell_size: int, loading_range: number, created: bool, already_exists?: bool, success: bool, saved: bool, message: string }`

## `get_hlod_layer_actors`

*Read-only.*

Enumerate which LOADED actors in the current editor world are assigned to a given UHLODLayer (read-side of set_hlod_layer_actors). Two limits worth knowing before you trust an empty result: it only sees actors currently loaded, and it is WORLD PARTITION ONLY -- on a non-WP world it returns not_applicable=true with a note instead of a list, because there the assignment would not survive a Generate anyway.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hlod_layer_path` | string | yes | Full /Game path of the UHLODLayer asset (matches against AActor::HLODLayer::GetPathName()). |

**Returns:** `{ hlod_layer_path, world, is_world_partition, not_applicable, note?, total: int, actors: [{actor_name, actor_path, actor_label}] }`

## `get_hlod_layers`

*Read-only.*

Lists all UHLODLayer assets under a content path via the AssetRegistry.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no | Optional content path; defaults to /Game |

**Returns:** `{ path: string, hlod_layers: [{ name, path, layer_type }], count: int }`

## `remove_hlod_layer`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Delete a UHLODLayer asset at a /Game path, the mirror of create_hlod_layer. Typed delete: it loads the asset first and refuses one that is not a UHLODLayer with success false, its asset_class and a note, deleting nothing, so it cannot wipe the wrong asset the way the generic delete_asset can. Idempotent: a path with no asset is a no-op, success true with deleted=false and already_existed=false. The delete removes the asset and its file and cannot be undone; when the engine refuses it (Play-in-Editor running, an asset the Asset Registry does not list, a file it cannot delete) success is false with deleted=false. List layers with get_hlod_layers; inspect one with get_hlod_layer_info.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Full /Game/.../LayerName asset path. |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path, deleted, already_existed?, layer_type?, asset_class?, note? }`

## `set_hlod_layer_actors`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Assign a UHLODLayer to a BATCH of loaded actors in the current editor world -- or clear it from them by passing hlod_layer_path="". WORLD PARTITION ONLY: on a non-WP world it returns not_applicable=true and changes nothing. Idempotent per actor: one that already has that layer is not touched at all and comes back counted as unchanged, so the changed/unchanged/cleared split tells you exactly what really moved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_paths` | array | yes | JSON array of actor paths (long package paths or object paths) to assign. |
| `hlod_layer_path` | string | no | Full /Game path of the UHLODLayer asset. Pass empty string ("") to clear. |

**Returns:** `{ hlod_layer_path, world, is_world_partition, not_applicable, note?, requested: int, changed: int, unchanged: int, cleared: int, not_found: [paths], changed_actors: [{actor_path, old_hlod_layer, new_hlod_layer}] }`

## `set_hlod_layer_parent`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets (or clears) the parent UHLODLayer of a UHLODLayer and saves it.  The parent chain drives nested HLOD generation (a layer's HLOD becomes an input to its parent's HLOD). Send parent_layer_path="" to clear the parent to null; omit parent_layer_path to leave it untouched. Idempotent: if the parent is already the requested value, nothing is modified/saved (changed_parent=false, saved=false). Validates against self-parent and circular parent chains (the engine's guard is editor-only and does not run headless).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hlod_layer_path` | string | yes | Full /Game path to the child HLOD layer asset |
| `parent_layer_path` | string | no | Optional full /Game path to the parent HLOD layer; "" clears to null; absent leaves it untouched |

**Returns:** `{ hlod_layer_path: string, asset_path: string, parent_layer_path: string, has_parent: bool, changed_parent: bool, settings_set: bool, saved: bool, note: string? }`

## `set_hlod_layer_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets streaming-grid settings / layer type on a UHLODLayer and saves it.  Partial update: only the fields you send are touched. Sending cell_size or loading_range also enables the layer spatially loaded. Layer type accepts 'Instancing'|'MeshApproximate'|'Custom'|'CustomHLODActor'.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hlod_layer_path` | string | yes | Full /Game path to the HLOD layer asset |
| `cell_size` | number | no | Optional streaming-grid cell size |
| `loading_range` | number | no | Optional streaming-grid loading range |
| `layer_type` | string | no | Optional EHLODLayerType string |

**Returns:** `{ hlod_layer_path: string, asset_path: string, layer_type: string, cell_size: int, loading_range: number, changed_cell_size: bool, changed_loading_range: bool, changed_layer_type: bool, settings_set: bool, saved: bool }`
